description: Deterministic best-match pairs of Signature AIs and Signature robot bodies. Pair n of 1,000,000 always resolves to the same AI + body + mission.
for_bots: Pair deep links: ?pair=JAH-PAIR-###### (crawler-readable query URLs listed in sitemap.xml). Body deep links: ?body=JAH-BOT-######. Compact pair index at data/index/pairs.idx.json.gz rows [pair_id, ai_name, body_name, mission, chunk_n]. Modular pair sitemap batches: sitemap-pairs-N.xml (1000/batch) via sitemap-index.xml. Standardized feed at data/pairs-catalog.json (id, AI, body, class, mission, score, url). Pre-rendered static pair tables at pairs-index.html.
site: The Signature AI to Robot Matcher
